content: Routine diabetes check-ups for youth should include comprehensive psychosocial assessments. These assessments must address various aspects such as stress management, the presence of disordered eating behaviors, family dynamics, and any concerns related to behavioral health. The care team managing diabetes in children and adolescents should consist of professionals who are well-versed in child development. Their expertise ensures that the care provided is tailored to the unique needs of this age group. Adolescents with type 1 diabetes should be actively encouraged to participate in their own care. Discussions about their health and treatment should be conducted in a manner that is developmentally appropriate, ensuring that the information is accessible and relevant to their age and level of understanding.
